narrative.intro: Applied Research Solutions has $242M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date, spread across 7 awards with an average award size of $34.5M. Obligations are down 9.4% year over year. The Department of Defense is the dominant buyer, accounting for $235M of obligations, followed by the General Services Administration with $6.4M. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) is the largest market at $223M. Other reported markets include Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $11.9M, Engineering Services at $6.4M, and Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services at $921K. Fiscal-year totals show variability over recent years, with previous obligations of $207M in FY21, $213M in FY22, $238M in FY23, $208M in FY24, and $267M in FY25. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity only.

sections.heading: Who are Applied Research Solutions' biggest federal buyers?
sections.body: The Department of Defense is the largest buyer, with $235M in obligations for FY2026 to date. The General Services Administration is a distant second at $6.4M. No other agencies are listed among the top buyers in the provided figures.

sections.heading: What markets and services does Applied Research Solutions sell to the government?
sections.body: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) is the primary market at $223M. The firm also sells work categorized as Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $11.9M, Engineering Services at $6.4M, and Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services at $921K.

faq.q: How much does Applied Research Solutions make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Applied Research Solutions has $242M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. The company won 7 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $34.5M, and obligations are down 9.4% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Applied Research Solutions?
faq.a: The Department of Defense and the General Services Administration buy from Applied Research Solutions. The Department of Defense accounts for $235M in obligations and the General Services Administration accounts for $6.4M for FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does Applied Research Solutions sell to the government?
faq.a: Applied Research Solutions sells research and engineering services to the government. Reported markets include Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) at $223M; Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $11.9M; Engineering Services at $6.4M; and Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services at $921K.
